name: Grok (grok.com)
description: Capability package for Grok's web chat at https://grok.com. Sends prompts through the site composer and reads streamed answers off the page. STATIC ANALYSIS ONLY: grok.com is hard-blocked for non-browser clients at the Cloudflare WAF edge (403 JSD challenge), so the chat transport is UNVERIFIED and marked to-be-identified on first headed live capture. Auth surface (cookie kind, sso + sso-rw) is from capabilities/provider-catalog.md grok-web entry; sibling marketing SPA at x.ai was analyzable but contains no chat wire endpoints.
author: ui2api capabilities
siteVersion: grok.com: no HTML/bundles retrievable (Cloudflare WAF 403 block on all probed paths) — build pin unknown; sibling x.ai marketing SPA served a Next.js/Turbopack build (chunks under /_next/static/chunks/, dpl pin f5496767b0e65480015db0d425ea15a2380ba3ef)

transport.protocol: UNKNOWN — grok.com answers plain-curl probes (all paths, both HTTP versions, Chrome+Safari UAs) with Cloudflare 'Sorry, you have been blocked' 403 + JS detection (JSD) challenge at /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/scripts/jsd/main.js. No endpoint, payload shape, or streaming format is documented here because none was observable; NO endpoint names are fabricated.
